entries.name: Create Easy Text Report
entries.description: Allows you to pass in a block of text along with optional formatting information and print the report to a designated printer or publish the report to a specified file path.

terminals.name: font settings
terminals.description: font settings indicates the font settings a report uses.

terminals.name: weight (-1)
terminals.description: weight is the thickness of the font. The default is -1.

terminals.name: name
terminals.description: name is the font name.

terminals.name: size
terminals.description: size is the font size.

terminals.name: print or save?
terminals.description: print or save? specifies whether the VI prints or saves the report. The default is print . Set this input to save if you specify a file path in printer name or file path .

terminals.name: margins
terminals.description: margins sets the page margins to use when printing the report.

terminals.name: left
terminals.description: left sets the distance in inches or centimeters between the left edge of the page and the left edge of the content on the page.

terminals.name: right
terminals.description: right sets the distance in inches or centimeters between the right edge of the page and the right edge of the content on the page.

terminals.name: bottom
terminals.description: bottom sets the distance in inches or centimeters between the bottom of the page and the bottom of the content on the page.

terminals.name: measurement system (default)
terminals.description: measurement system sets the units of measurement for the margins.

terminals.name: text to be printed
terminals.description: text to be printed is the information you want to include in the report. Any information you want to include must be in a string.

terminals.name: printer name (default) or file path (dialog)
terminals.description: printer name or file path is the name of the printer to which you want to print a report or the file path to which you want to send a report, depending on report type . If you specify a printer name, the printer must be configured for use with the computer from which you print the report. If you specify a file path, you must set the print or save? input to save . If you do not wire this input, the VI uses the default printer in LabVIEW.

terminals.name: report type (HTML)
terminals.description: report type is the type of report you want to create.

terminals.name: orientation (portrait)
terminals.description: orientation (Windows) specifies how the report appears when it prints.

terminals.name: error in (no error)
terminals.description: error in describes error conditions that occur before this node runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.

terminals.name: headers
terminals.description: headers specifies what information appears in the header of each page of the report.

terminals.name: center
terminals.description: center is the information you want to appear in the center portion of the header.

terminals.name: right
terminals.description: right is the information you want to appear in the right side of the header.

terminals.name: footers
terminals.description: footers specifies what information appears in the footer of each page of the report.

terminals.name: center
terminals.description: center is the information you want to appear in the center portion of the footer.

terminals.name: right

terminals.name: error out
